title: Create src/lib/agent-init.ts — .agent/ structure creator
description: Create the module responsible for setting up the .agent/ directory structure. Does not overwrite existing files. Creates all required subdirectories and placeholder files.
acceptanceCriteria: Creates .agent/PROMPT.md with default content if it doesn't exist
Creates .agent/tasks.json with empty task array if it doesn't exist
Running twice does not overwrite existing content

steps.details: Create the file. Import fs-extra and path. Define helper: async function writeIfAbsent(filePath: string, content: string): Promise<void> { if (await fs.pathExists(filePath)) return; await fs.ensureDir(path.dirname(filePath)); await fs.writeFile(filePath, content, 'utf-8') }

Define constants: DEFAULT_PRD_MD (markdown with placeholder sections), DEFAULT_SUMMARY_MD (placeholder), DEFAULT_LOG_MD ('# Loop Log\n'), DEFAULT_PROMPT_MD (AI instructions with complete/blocked/decide tags), EMPTY_TASKS_JSON ('{"tasks":[]}')

export async function createAgentStructure(projectPath: string): Promise<void> { const agentDir = path.join(projectPath, '.agent'); await fs.ensureDir(path.join(agentDir, 'history')); await writeIfAbsent(path.join(agentDir, 'prd', 'PRD.md'), DEFAULT_PRD_MD); await writeIfAbsent(path.join(agentDir, 'prd', 'SUMMARY.md'), DEFAULT_SUMMARY_MD); await writeIfAbsent(path.join(agentDir, 'logs', 'LOG.md'), DEFAULT_LOG_MD); await writeIfAbsent(path.join(agentDir, 'PROMPT.md'), DEFAULT_PROMPT_MD); await writeIfAbsent(path.join(agentDir, 'tasks.json'), EMPTY_TASKS_JSON) }
Call createAgentStructure() twice on the same directory. Verify that existing files are NOT overwritten (compare modification timestamps or file contents).

technicalNotes: writeIfAbsent uses fs.pathExists() to check before writing — this ensures idempotent behavior
fs.ensureDir is idempotent — safe to call even if the directory exists
